name: AeroTab
description:
A 3D "Flip" style Alt+Tab window switcher.

The selected window stands in the middle, facing you; the others line up on both sides, tilted like the walls of a corridor, with a reflection on the floor. Two styles: Dark (black background) and Desktop (your wallpaper, blurred and dimmed).

Alt+Tab moves forward, Alt+Shift+Tab moves back, releasing Alt switches to the selected window, Esc cancels. Arrow keys, mouse wheel and clicks also work, and the X button closes the selected window. Turning AeroTab off (or the extension) brings back the default GNOME Alt+Tab.
